description: Adform video, impression, and click tags on regional tracking domains, whose banner number rides as bn and whose click index rides as C.

params.name: bn
params.description: It is the numeric Adform banner ID. Adform documents video tags as `{region}.adform.net/videoad/?bn=` plus that ID. a2 is the Americas tracking domain, track is EMEA, a1 is global, asia is APAC.
params.fix_hint: Set `bn` to the banner ID from the Adform tag.

params.name: C
params.description: It is the click index Adform writes on multi-click banners. Adform documents clicktrackers as `C=1`, `C=2`, and so on. Single-click tags omit it.
params.fix_hint: Set `C` to the click index from the Adform tag, or drop the pair on a single-click tag.

params.name: cpdir
params.description: Adform documents cpdir as the absolute replacement landing page URL.

params.name: urlappend
params.description: Adform appends query data to the landing page. Its supported __ADFSEP__ macro resolves to ? or & depending on the destination query.
